result.topic_en: Riemann defines a continuously extended manifold as a set of determination modes with continuous transitions, then works through divergence-free vector fields, their curl components, a vector potential with zero divergence obtained from a Newtonian potential integral, and an energy-type integral of squared derivatives.
result.transcription:
Wenn unter einer Menge von Bestimmungsweisen eines Gegenstandes von jeder zu jeder andern ein stetiger Übergang stattfindet, so bildet die Gesammtheit dieser Bestimmungsweisen eine stetig ausgedehnte Mannigfaltigkeit.
$\frac{\partial X_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial X_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial X_3}{\partial x_3}=0$ \quad $X_1dx_1+X_2dx_2+X_3dx_3=0$
$\frac{\partial X_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial X_2}{\partial x_1}=\iota_3$
$\frac{\partial X_2}{\partial x_3}-\frac{\partial X_3}{\partial x_2}=\iota_1$ \quad $\frac{\partial \iota_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial \iota_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial \iota_3}{\partial x_3}=0$
$\partial X_3 \quad =\iota_2$
$\iota_1 dx_1 dx_2$
$\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}=X_3$
$u_1+\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial x_1}$ \quad $u_1$
$[-\partial-]\ \Delta_1 u=0 \quad =\iota_1$
$\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2\lambda}{\partial x^2}\ldots=\varrho$
$\lambda=\frac{1}{4\pi}\int\frac{\varrho\,dx_1dx_2dx_3}{r}$
$\int\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}\right.$
